item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera connects a small lamp to an electric cell using copper wires in her classroom. In which arrangement will the lamp glow?
A lamp glows only when there is a complete conducting path from one terminal of the cell, through the lamp, and back to the other terminal of the cell.

options.A: one wire connects one terminal of the cell to one side of the lamp, with no wire back to the cell
options.B: one wire joins one terminal of the cell to the lamp, and a second wire joins the other side of the lamp to the other terminal of the cell
options.C: two wires connect both sides of the lamp to the same terminal of the cell
options.D: the lamp is simply held touching one terminal of the cell with no wires
